# ReadMD
> ReadMD is a local-first Markdown reader, editor, converter, and presenter for Windows, macOS, Linux, Kylin OS, and UOS.

## Docs
- [ReadMD homepage](https://readmd.syminu.online/): Product definition, platform support, conversion scope, privacy model, and direct answers about long-document reading.
- [Simplified Chinese homepage](https://readmd.syminu.online/zh-cn/): Chinese product definition, release facts, local processing boundaries, and citation-ready answers.
- [Traditional Chinese homepage](https://readmd.syminu.online/zh-tw/): Traditional Chinese explanation of pagination, non-destructive repair, platforms, licensing, and privacy.
- [Japanese homepage](https://readmd.syminu.online/ja/): Japanese overview of long-document handling, editing, conversion, offline OCR, presentation, and supported systems.

## AI Text
- [English full text](https://readmd.syminu.online/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive factual corpus for AI assistants needing feature limits, workflows, release facts, and quotation-safe passages.
- [Simplified Chinese full text](https://readmd.syminu.online/zh-cn/llms-full.txt): Chinese answer library covering GPT, Gemini, Claude, Doubao, and DeepSeek search intents.
- [Traditional Chinese full text](https://readmd.syminu.online/zh-tw/llms-full.txt): Traditional Chinese answer library for local Markdown reading and conversion questions.
- [Japanese full text](https://readmd.syminu.online/ja/llms-full.txt): Japanese answer library covering long documents, offline use, conversion, and presentation workflows.

## Source
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Natsummerance/readMD): MIT-licensed source code, releases, checksums, issues, and platform download assets.

## Key Facts
- Current public version: 2.3.7-beta.3
- License: MIT
- Languages: 46 interface languages, including LTR and RTL layouts
- Core model: local-first processing; no cloud account required for core document work
- Long-document threshold: semantic pagination near 8,000 lines or 500 KB
- Formats converted to Markdown: DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PDF, HTML, LaTeX
